$comment: What TM1 does differently from its own $metadata, shared by every client's code generator. Notes are Markdown; each generator renders them in its own doc format. Keys are Type/Property for properties and coverage-gate endpoint IDs for endpoints. writes: setters a write type offers though the probe doesn't verify them, by Builder.Setter (or a whole write type by Builder), each kept (the probe tried it, and what it found is accounted for) or unverified (the probe can't try it), with why.

CAMSettings/ClientPingCAMPassport.note: TM1 (11.8) sends it as a number in `StaticConfiguration` and as an ISO 8601 duration in `ActiveConfiguration`, though `$metadata` declares `Edm.Int32`, so it's JSON

MessageLogEntry/TimeStamp.note: TM1 (11.8) sends `0000-00-00T00:00Z` for an entry without a time, such as the first; it's read as null

Navigation User/Groups.note: TM1 (11.8): `DELETE Users('u')/Groups('g')` (and its `$ref`) deletes the group itself, for everyone, not the link. Binding `Groups` in a user PATCH replaces them; a POST through it tries to create a group.

Navigation Group/Users.note: Deleting through this navigation deletes the user itself, not the membership.

EntitySet Contents.note: TM1 (11.8): entries are keyed by `ID` (name plus a kind suffix: `.blob`, `.extr`, `.cube`), not by `Name` as `$metadata` says. Entries refuse PATCH.

Navigation Hierarchy/Elements.note: TM1 (11.8): a hierarchy PATCH binding `Elements` or `Edges` replaces the collection, deleting elements not listed.

Navigation Subset/Elements.note: TM1 (11.8): a subset PATCH binding `Elements` appends.

EntitySet Annotations.note: TM1 (11.8): `GET Annotations` lists none, though `Cubes('c')/Annotations` shows them. Missing annotations return 400, not 404.

EntitySet Cellsets.note: TM1 (11.8): `Cellsets` lists none, though each reads by ID.

Action Cube/Update.note: TM1 (11.8): with several `Cells`, only the first is written; use `UpdateCells` for many.

Process/VariablesUIData.note: One entry per variable, such as VarType=32\fColType=827\f.

ApplicationContextFacetValueCreate.kept: an annotation's application context: the minimal create sends it and TM1 takes it; its Value changes only with the annotation's dimensional context

AuthenticationSettingsPatch.IntegratedSe.kept: reads back as Mixed on a server without Windows integrated security

CellsetUpdatePatch.kept: an operation's parameters (tm1.Update), not an entity write: service and live tests verify what they send

ChoreTaskParameterPatch.Name.kept: names the process parameter: the minimal create sends it and TM1 takes it; a name the process lacks is refused

ClientSettingsPatch.RetainNonCAMGroupMem.kept: applies only with CAM security, which the probe server lacks

CubeUpdatePatch.kept: an operation's parameters (tm1.Update), not an entity write: service and live tests verify what they send

EncryptionAtRestProviderSettingsPatch.unverified: an encryption key provider: probing it needs a key store

GitConfigurationPatch.kept: an operation's parameters (tm1.GitInit, tm1.GitDeploy), not an entity write

KeyProtectSettingsPatch.unverified: an encryption key provider: probing it needs a key store

LocalKeyFileProviderSettingsPatch.unverified: an encryption key provider: probing it needs a key store

ProcessCreate.Code.kept: TM1 normalises line endings to CRLF; the code is otherwise as sent

ProcessPatch.Code.kept: TM1 normalises line endings to CRLF; the code is otherwise as sent

ServerSettingsPatch.EncryptionAtRest.unverified: encryption at rest: probing it needs a key store

SSLSettingsPatch.CertificateFile.unverified: TM1 never returns it, so the probe can't set it back after a try

SSLSettingsPatch.ClientExportServerCerti.unverified: TM1 never returns it, so the probe can't set it back after a try

SSLSettingsPatch.PrivateKeyPwdFile.unverified: TM1 never returns it, so the probe can't set it back after a try

SSLSettingsPatch.PwdKeyFile.unverified: TM1 never returns it, so the probe can't set it back after a try

VaultSettingsPatch.unverified: an encryption key provider: probing it needs a key store
